A rollicking summer at Shakespeare’s Globe continues with this raucously entertaining take on As It, a surpassingly sweet play that seems here to take its cue from a passing reference near the end to “rustic revelry”.

cn.t: This crowd-pleasing Globe production fizzes with energy and humor, with critics praising its playful performances, feminist focus, and clear storytelling that lets Shakespeare's text shine in a raucously entertaining revival.
